newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila business club sees steady March inflation.
newsitem.headline: Manila business club sees steady March inflation.

text.p: The Makati Business Club, an organisation of top business executives in the Philippines, has forecast an inflation rate of between 4.3 and 4.4 percent for March, executive director Guillermo Luz said on Thursday.
Inflation hit 4.4 percent, the lowest since 1987, in February.
In a statement, Luz said stable commodity prices and declining oil prices should slow inflation.
He added that the peso-dollar exchange rate had depreciated by a meagre 0.13 percent from February.
A recent Reuters poll showed that economists were expecting a slight uptick in March inflation to 4.62 percent.
